description: Add your vehicle operating, ownership and driver costs, then divide by productive miles for the same period. Use this tested BusCalc worksheet when the task matches its inputs and scope. Returns named results, units, formula, assumptions, method version and a source-page URL. No prices or omitted costs are looked up; no private projects or purchases are accessed. Supply units.distance explicitly as mi or km. For miles, use units: {"distance":"mi"}. Put tool fields inside inputs. Supply units or modelVersion only when listed in inputSchema. Follow its required fields and exact choices. Do not pass the REST calculator field inside MCP arguments.

costs.description: Vehicle ownership operating and driver costs in period. Enter one distinct cost per row, or one known total. Do not enter both a total and its components. Choose a cost category if helpful; it does not calculate or add that cost. One row per distinct vehicle ownership operating and driver costs in period, on the stated row and period basis. Do not enter both components and their total.

amount.description: Amount for this cost in the stated period. Matching invoice, quote, statement, bookkeeping record or explicit budget amount for cost amount. Use the stated period and exclude amounts already counted in another field. Zero means intentionally excluded/not incurred, not unknown. JSON numbers are preferred. Nonblank strings are also accepted when JavaScript Number conversion yields a finite value meeting the same bounds and whole-number rules.

costCategory.description: Cost category — optional label. This label helps identify your cost rows and appears with saved inputs. It does not select a rate, add an expense or change the arithmetic. Choose Other for any unlisted cost.

distance.description: Productive / billable distance for that same period. From your trip log, enter only productive or billable miles (or select kilometres). Include all trip costs above, including empty travel. This worksheet specifically measures cost per productive distance; do not mistake it for cost per all odometer miles. JSON numbers are preferred. Nonblank strings are also accepted when JavaScript Number conversion yields a finite value meeting the same bounds and whole-number rules.

reportingPeriod.description: Period used for ALL costs and distance. This is a scope label only. It does not convert annual insurance to a monthly cost or change your distance. Allocate every amount to the same period before entering it.

modelVersion.description: Optional expected method version; a mismatch is rejected.

distance.description: Explicit unit for Productive / billable distance for that same period

name: buscalc_fleet_cost_per_mile
title: Fleet cost per mile
